seo.title: Your Company — clothing brand and showroom in Tashkent
seo.description: Capsule collections in linen, cotton and satin, sewn in Tashkent in small runs. Showroom on Mirabad, fittings by appointment, delivery across Uzbekistan.
seo.answer: Your Company is a clothing brand from Tashkent: capsule collections in linen, cotton and satin, sewn in small runs in our own workshop. Prices run from 390,000 UZS for a T-shirt to 1,850,000 UZS for a coat; the showroom at 21 Mirabad St is open daily, with delivery in Tashkent in 1 day and across Uzbekistan in 2–4 days.

sections.label: About
sections.title: We make less, so that every piece lasts longer
sections.text: Your Company began in 2021 in a workshop on Mirabad. We buy fabric from mills in Fergana and Namangan, and cut and sew everything ourselves in a workshop of 14 seamstresses. Each collection is 20–30 styles, with no more than 60 pieces of each; once a style sells out, we don’t remake it. The label carries the piece’s number and the name of the seamstress who made it.

items.q: How do I choose my size?
items.a: Every style lists its measurements in centimetres. If you’re unsure, send your height and measurements on Telegram and we’ll advise within 15 minutes.

items.q: Can I try things on before buying?
items.a: Yes, at the showroom at 21 Mirabad St. It’s best to book ahead so we can have your sizes ready.
Within Tashkent it’s 30,000 UZS, free over 1,000,000 UZS, in 1 day. Across Uzbekistan it takes 2–4 days at the courier’s rate.
Yes, within 14 days if it hasn’t been worn and the tags are attached. We refund using the method you paid with.
Yes, we adjust trouser and sleeve length for free, usually in 1–2 days.

items.q: Will a sold-out style come back?
items.a: No: every style is a limited run and we don’t remake what has sold out. New collections arrive twice a year.
